model_name: Astra property droplet W0: conditional conservation references

target.description: Equivalent-volume liquid diameter from explicit liquid component inventories and additive supplied liquid volumes; experimental conditional property kernel.
excludes: finite-rate ignition, cool flame or extinction
gravity or velocity transport without supplied effective-film closure
nonideal mixtures and differential gas diffusivity

features.name: initial_component_masses
features.source: declared initial liquid inventory with provenance and component identities

features.name: liquid_temperature
features.source: declared initial liquid state with provenance

features.name: ambient_component_mass_fractions
features.source: declared keyed volatile species mass fractions with provenance

features.name: component_liquid_vapor_properties
features.source: Material typed input: molar mass, liquid density, liquid/vapor cp, latent heat and saturation pressure at common reference; domains and provenance mandatory

features.name: gas_transport
features.source: Transport typed input: rhoD and conductivity, or supplied conductances with explicit validity envelope

features.name: gravity
features.source: declared vector and coordinate frame with provenance

features.name: velocity
features.source: declared imposed velocity vector and coordinate frame with provenance

features.name: external_heat
features.source: explicit signed heat into liquid, excluding the gas heat calculated by this kernel

features.name: thermodynamic_reference
features.source: reference temperature, gas constant, carrier molar mass and enthalpy reference identity with provenance

features.name: elapsed_time
features.source: elapsed time since explicit initial time origin

features.name: numerical_controls
features.source: caller time increment and typed absolute/relative arithmetic budgets

tensors.name: geometry.pi
tensors.description: Mathematical pi, nearest binary64; no tunable material, chemistry or transport weights. Role is an inventory slot, not an empirical physical constant.

notes: Bounded unregistered kernel specification. Structured feature binding and module registration require coordinator integration; this is not an existing ForecastRequest adapter. Kernel enforces strictly positive temperature/pressure, supplier domains, complete keyed inventories and provenance beyond these coarse numeric bounds. Advance integrates component mass and total enthalpy with explicit Euler. IsothermalReference and FlameSheetReference are separately labelled conditional analytic APIs documented in the research ledger, not silently selected by the primary forward. No NASA or development outcomes were read by the numerical author. No noise, hazard or optical model is supplied.
